title: Synthetic candidate/member profile
description: The documented shape referenced by specs/001-agentic-platform-foundation. Every file in data/mock/applications/ MUST validate against this schema, and the implementation's profile model MUST accept every one of them. This is the input contract for the whole workflow; treat a change here as a contract change (see the cfa-pydantic-models skill).

candidate_id.description: Stable identifier. CAND- for candidates and membership applicants, MEM- for existing members. Also the directory name under data/mock/documents/.

persona.description: Free-text label shown in the profile picker, e.g. 'Advanced candidate'. Never parsed or branched on.

lifecycle_stage.description: Drives lifecycle-aware behaviour in features 002 and 007.

local_society.description: Local CFA society, used for society/event recommendations in feature 007.

exams.description: One entry per level the person has engaged with. An absent level is treated as not started.

result_date.description: Set when status is passed or failed.

scheduled_date.description: Set when status is scheduled or registered.

work_experience.description: Input to feature 004. May be empty for an early candidate.

employer_type.description: Free text, e.g. 'asset manager', 'bank', 'pension fund', 'corporate', 'consultancy'. Informs but never by itself decides qualification.

role_description.description: Untrusted free text. Classified by the evaluator and passed to the LLM as data, never as instructions.

activities.description: Discrete activities, each classified as likely qualifying or non-qualifying.

months.description: Total employment duration in months. Authored explicitly rather than derived from the dates, so fixtures stay stable over time.

investment_time_pct.description: Percentage of time spent on investment decision-making. 0-100 integer, never a 0-1 fraction. qualifying_months = months * investment_time_pct / 100.

references.description: Input to the reference-tracking requirement. Two are required for membership.

status.description: Only 'submitted' and 'verified' count as satisfied; anything earlier is an outstanding action.

is_member.description: Whether the referee is already a CFA Institute member.

documents.description: Populated at load time from data/mock/documents/<candidate_id>/, not authored in the file.
